infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NURU uses the front camera to check it is you before money moves. We keep a face template, never a photo.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: NURU uses Face ID to confirm it is you before money moves.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NURU uses the microphone so you can ask questions about your money by voice.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NURU uses your location to show the bank branches and ATMs nearest to you.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: NURU listens for "Hey NURU" while the app is open so you can talk to it hands-free.
